name: mail_search
description: Search mail by keyword. Read-only. Returns message summaries with full IDs.

name: mail_unread
description: List unread Inbox messages, newest first. Read-only. Returns message summaries.

name: mail_read
description: Read one message by full ID: headers, recipients, body text, attachments and links. Read-only.

name: mail_attachments
description: List attachments on a message (id, name, contentType, size, isInline). Read-only.

name: mail_download_attachments
description: Download file attachments to an absolute directory on this machine. Skips inline images unless named in attachment_ids. Writes files.

name: mail_links
description: List links in a message body. By default only SharePoint/OneDrive share links. Read-only.

name: mail_folders
description: List top-level mail folders with unread and total counts. Read-only.

name: mail_create_folder
description: Create a mail folder. Omit parent_id for the top level; otherwise use a full folder ID or well-known name such as inbox. Changes mailbox state. Never retry automatically after an uncertain result.

name: mail_mark_read
description: Mark a message read or unread. Changes mailbox state.

name: mail_move
description: Move a message to a folder given by name (e.g. 'inbox', 'archive', a display name) or ID. Changes mailbox state.

name: mail_archive
description: Move a message to the Archive folder. Changes mailbox state.

name: mail_query
description: Search mail with exact address and date filters. Filters apply to fetched pages. Use all_pages for exhaustive structured queries. Keyword searches can have a server-side limit. Keep all filters unchanged for a continuation page. Read-only.

name: mail_conversation
description: Read every accessible message in a conversation, oldest first, including bodies and attachment metadata. Read-only. Does not download attachment bytes.

name: mail_bulk
description: Preview archive, trash, move, mark-read or mark-unread for explicit message IDs. Apply only with confirm=true after user approval. Stops after a failed or uncertain write. Never retry uncertain results automatically. No permanent deletion.

name: mail_trash
description: Preview a move to Deleted Items. Set confirm=true only after user approval. No permanent deletion.

name: mail_categories
description: List master categories through Graph. Requires MailboxSettings.Read.

name: mail_category_create
description: Preview a category creation. Set confirm=true to create it. Requires MailboxSettings.ReadWrite. Colour: none or preset0..preset24.

name: mail_category_update
description: Preview a category colour update. Set confirm=true to apply it. Requires MailboxSettings.ReadWrite. A category name cannot change.

name: mail_category_delete
description: Preview a master category deletion. Set confirm=true to delete it. Requires MailboxSettings.ReadWrite.

name: mail_categorise
description: Preview category changes on full Graph message IDs, not cached indices. Set confirm=true to apply. Requires Mail.ReadWrite. REST v2 IDs may differ from Graph IDs. Returns per-message results; a failed write stops the batch. Never retry an uncertain result automatically.

name: mail_rules
description: List inbox rules through Graph. Requires MailboxSettings.Read.

name: mail_rule_create
description: Preview an inbox rule. Set confirm=true to create it. Rules start disabled unless enabled=true. Requires MailboxSettings.ReadWrite. Use Graph lowerCamelCase JSON: conditions fromAddresses (recipient objects), subjectContains; actions moveToFolder (Graph folder ID), assignCategories, markAsRead, stopProcessingRules. Other fields and dangerous actions are rejected.

name: mail_rule_update
description: Preview a rule update. Set confirm=true to apply it. Requires MailboxSettings.ReadWrite. Changes accept displayName, sequence, isEnabled, conditions and actions in Graph lowerCamelCase. Unknown keys and dangerous actions fail validation. An enable request also checks the current rule.

name: mail_rule_delete
description: Preview an inbox rule deletion. Set confirm=true to delete it. Requires MailboxSettings.ReadWrite.

name: draft_create
description: Create a new email draft in Outlook Drafts with the Aptos style and new-message signature. Does not send.

name: draft_reply
description: Create a reply draft to an existing message with the reply signature and quoted original. Does not send.

name: draft_update
description: Edit a draft. Omitted fields stay unchanged; empty fields clear. Does not send.

name: draft_forward
description: Create a forward draft with the reply signature and quoted original. Does not send.

name: draft_list
description: List drafts in the Drafts folder, newest first. Read-only.

name: draft_get
description: Get one draft by full ID, including recipients and body text. Read-only.

name: draft_delete
description: Delete a draft by full ID. Refuses to delete anything that is not a draft.

name: cal_agenda
description: List upcoming calendar events for the next N days. Read-only. Returns event summaries with full IDs.

name: cal_get
description: Get one calendar event by full ID, including attendees, body text and recurrence. Read-only.

name: cal_availability
description:
Get free/busy for people or rooms between two local times, decoded. Read-only.

Returns each attendee's non-free ranges (busy, tentative, outOfOffice, workingElsewhere)
and their Outlook working hours, plus commonFree windows between day_start and day_end
where no attendee is busy or out of office. Each window lists attendees who are
tentative or outside their own working hours; clear=true means neither.
Times are in the configured local timezone. include_raw adds Outlook's digit string.

name: cal_find_time
description:
Find meeting slots where no attendee is busy or out of office. Read-only. Creates nothing.

Computed from Outlook free/busy, between day_start and day_end local time.
Best slots first: clear slots, then slots with the fewest tentative attendees or
attendees outside their own working hours, then by start time.

name: cal_create
description: Create a calendar event. WARNING: if attendees are given, Outlook emails invitations to them immediately. Omit attendees for a private event.

name: cal_respond
description: Accept, tentatively accept or decline an invitation. WARNING: when send_response is true, the organizer is emailed your response.

name: contact_search
description: Search the org directory and recent contacts by name or email. Read-only.

name: task_list
description: List incomplete tasks. Read-only.

name: task_create
description: Create a task in Outlook Tasks. Changes mailbox data.

name: task_complete
description: Mark a task as completed. Changes mailbox data.

name: teams_list
description: List recent Teams chats, newest activity first. Read-only.

name: teams_search
description: Search recent chats by topic or participant. Use one_on_one to find a person's chat. Use include_messages to read recent messages. Read-only. Increase scan/count if searchIncomplete is true.

name: teams_messages
description: Read recent messages in a Teams chat by full chat ID, newest first. Read-only.

name: teams_attachments
description: List file attachments and SharePoint/OneDrive links in the latest messages of a chat. Read-only.

name: teams_download_attachments
description: Download Teams attachments or share links from a chat to an absolute directory. `attachment` is a 1-based index from teams_attachments, a URL, or a name fragment; omit for all. Writes files.

name: files_sites
description: List SharePoint sites (Microsoft 365 groups) you are a member of. Read-only.

name: files_libraries
description: List document libraries in a SharePoint site (partial, case-insensitive site name). Read-only.

name: files_list
description: List a folder in OneDrive, or in a SharePoint site when `site` is given. With a site and no path or library, lists the site's libraries. Read-only.

name: files_search
description: Search document libraries of a SharePoint site (site is required). Read-only. Returns items with webUrl.

name: files_download
description: Download a file to an absolute local path (file or directory). `item` is a path, or for SharePoint also a drive item ID. OneDrive is used when `site` is omitted. Writes a file.

name: copilot_ask
description: Ask Microsoft 365 Copilot a question. `files` are SharePoint/OneDrive URLs (such as webUrl from files_search), drive item IDs or paths (OneDrive unless `site` is given); Copilot reads them as context. For a follow-up, pass conversationId from an earlier result; Copilot keeps earlier files. NOT read-only: Copilot can use its own tools to create drafts and events, change Teams and SharePoint data, and more. Ask only for information; use the guarded tools here to send or change data. The result lists `toolCalls` and any `pendingConfirmations`, which are never confirmed. An answer can take a few minutes.

name: auth_status
description: Report whether the Outlook, Graph and Copilot tokens are present and valid, and minutes left. Read-only. If expired, run 'outlook-cli auth' in a terminal.
